summary: A new BLOCK opened this week in Gnosis: two unauthenticated JSON endpoints leak secret entity names and spoiler subtypes, confirmed live by direct fetch while writing this report. Eleven of twelve projects show a lower health score than 2026-08-02, but most of that reflects deeper measurement (Scheduler and Apothecary's first full lens fan-out since consolidation) surfacing real pre-existing defects, not fresh regressions. The intake-vs-closure crisis flagged as the #1 action last week is unresolved for a second consecutive report, and this run's own reconciliation work found a related defect: the bar-raise write step silently failed to reach the dashboard JSON for two projects for four days. Four of twelve projects now explicitly ask Kane to rule on build-vs-park.

topActions.label: Add live data-path assertions to release.ps1 for /api/answers, /preview.json, /search-index.json; the BLOCK is live-confirmed leaking secret content now
Decide the intake policy: cap what a bar-raise run may promote into actions[], now eight days undecided
Add a report-vs-JSON parity check to the bar-raise write procedure; two projects' dashboard numbers silently diverged from their own reports for four days
Guard batch queue-completion operations against mis-attributed notes; the same failure hit Scheduler, Apothecary, Chains, and Budget
Verify the Supabase JWT in the billing routes; any signed-in user can currently hijack another user's Stripe Billing Portal session
Back up before bulk-delete/merge/Plaid-sync; zero snapshots exist on a 649-transaction ledger that already lost real data once
Fix the Stripe webhook race and the escrow-status race; both are live money-path exposures
Force the four open build-vs-park decisions: Hordes, Apothecary, Scheduler, Budget
Propagate the Invoke-Git fix to the sibling scripts still carrying the PS 5.1 stderr-wrap / blind-lock-removal bugs
Add a backup for community judge ratings, KV-only with no snapshot, open 4 consecutive runs
